name: Infer: GPUStack (control plane)
short_desc: GPUStack GPU cluster manager: web UI, model catalog, vLLM/SGLang runners, Grafana
author: Morteza Rastgoo
description: GPUStack v2.3.1 server with the embedded worker. You deploy models from the web UI (admin / the generated password in the app settings). The worker starts each model as a separate runner container (vLLM, SGLang, ...) through the Docker socket. Built-in Prometheus + Grafana dashboards and an OpenAI-compatible gateway. Runner containers join the host NVIDIA MPS daemon through mirrored deployment (they copy this container's runtime, mounts and MPS env); deploy each model with env GPUSTACK_MODEL_RUNTIME_UID=1000 and GPUSTACK_MODEL_RUNTIME_GID=1000. The data dir uses the same path inside and outside the container so runner containers can mount model files from it.

form_fields.label: Models directory (host)
form_fields.hint: Host folder with your model weights. It is mounted read-only at the same path.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Generated at install. Log in as `admin`.

form_fields.label: Worker IP (host)
form_fields.hint: A host IP the app container can reach, not on your LAN: the docker0 IP (172.17.0.1) or the runtipi_tipi_main_network gateway (`docker network inspect runtipi_tipi_main_network`). Model runners bind it, and port 10150 is published only on it.
